subject.title: [Bug]: stuck-session recovery aborts healthy runs while the gateway's own event loop is stalled (memory pressure/swap) — gate recovery on liveness

question: Should the liveness gate remain a fixed 90-second heartbeat-delay cutoff, or scale with the effective configured stuck-session abort threshold?
rationale: The current guard likely fixes the reported default multi-minute stall, but choosing how aggressively recovery should defer for low custom thresholds changes the balance between preserving healthy work and releasing genuinely orphaned sessions.

options.title: Use threshold-aware gating
options.body: Defer active recovery when observer delay consumes a meaningful portion of the effective abort window and require a subsequent healthy interval before aborting.

options.title: Keep the fixed cutoff
options.body: Treat the current 90-second guard as sufficient for supported defaults and document that unusually low custom abort thresholds reduce false-positive protection.

recommendation.title: Use threshold-aware gating
recommendation.body: Defer active recovery when observer delay consumes a meaningful portion of the effective abort window and require a subsequent healthy interval before aborting.
